title: The Ribbon Used from the Gift Drawer
youtube_title: The Ribbon Used from the Gift Drawer | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Hiding a dent does not make the dent untrue.
summary: At a kitchen table with jam, butter, and a shared pencil tin, Golda is tangled up with a ribbon used from the gift drawer without asking and almost hides it. Golda tells Ms. Okonkwo the plain truth, and together they mend what can be mended, with no teasing.
